long_biography.plain_text:
An engineering background led Ignace Vantorre into telecommunications. He established two companies in fibre-optic and network engineering in the late 1990s, sold them, then invested his own money in a new way to handle construction paperwork. Sogelink's online service digitized the declarations required before work near utility networks. With colleagues and successive investment partners, he grew that initial tool into a wider suite of cloud software for infrastructure and building projects.

After more than two decades guiding Sogelink, Vantorre shifted his attention toward the design and restoration of distinctive places. His hospitality collection brings together properties selected for their setting, history and privacy, with each site reworked around architecture and hospitality. The venture builds on his enthusiasm for choosing spaces and managing their transformation. Its team curates stays around local character and understated service, drawing guests into properties that had already captured Vantorre's imagination long before they were opened to visitors.
